title: Sunday Tomato Sauce (Sample)
description: A simple example recipe to show how the cookbook works. Replace it with one of Mom's recipes.
steps: Warm the olive oil in a saucepan over medium heat and soften the onion for 5 minutes.
Stir in garlic for 30 seconds, then add tomatoes, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Simmer gently for 30–40 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Finish with torn basil and serve over pasta.
